conditions: CORS-DISABLED RENDERING PROBE (non-representative). Checks performed via CDP against the live authenticated DOM.

trustStateNotColorAlone.evidence: .trust-banner-marker text (OK / ! / i) plus a text label accompany every banner; not signalled by color alone

ariaRolesPresent.evidence: role=status for positive/info banners, role=alert for warning/critical banners; enables screen-reader announcement of trust state

markersAriaHidden.evidence: decorative markers carry aria-hidden=true so screen readers announce the label/description, not the glyph

focusVisibleOutline.evidence: a non-'none' outline was observed on focused controls during Tab traversal

sourceCardLinkFocusable.evidence: the Tab probe started at the composer and moved forward; source-card pills above were not reached in this pass. Reachability/role of source-card pills should be confirmed explicitly.

contrastMinimum_5p73.evidence: in-page WCAG contrast computation returned inconsistent values (1.11 for positive/critical, 15.3 for warning) indicating a measurement bug; visual inspection shows readable dark-on-tint text at all sizes. The PHASE-10A3-R1 ~5.73:1 claim was NOT independently re-measured.

touchTargetSizing.evidence: deferred; recommend measuring composer/send/source-card hit areas at mobile widths

readingOrderReducedWidth.evidence: mobile-320 screenshot shows preserved reading order (answer -> trust banner -> source summary)

toolUsed: custom CDP DOM/keyboard probe (no axe available in-session)
recommendation: Complete accessibility acceptance with axe + manual keyboard/screen-reader passes after the CORS blocker is fixed, including a corrected WCAG contrast measurement to confirm the ~5.73:1 target and explicit source-card focus/touch-target checks.
